description: Captures permission requests, tool failures (with error text and class), interrupts, and user-correction signals, plus a daily per-tool call counter; runs a daily analyzer via direct Anthropic API call; produces a local digest + opt-in Resend email; opt-in real-time security alerts and opt-in confidence-gated auto-apply. Cross-clone-safe via fcntl file locks. Webhook publisher seam is dormant by default.
name: autoheal
